references.text: Moab was the son of Lot through his eldest daughter, which explains why God gave the land of Ar to Moab's descendants as an inheritance.
Mentions Ar as a city of Moab and describes the people of Moab, who are called the people of Chemosh.
A similar command not to attack the Ammonites, who were also descendants of Lot.
A parallel command not to attack the descendants of Esau, because God gave them the mountains of Seir as an inheritance.
Refers to Israel not taking land from Moab or Ammon, in accordance with God's command in Deuteronomy.
Jehoshaphat reminds that Israel did not attack Moab and Ammon when they came out of Egypt because God forbade it.
A prophecy concerning Moab and the city of Ar, which is mentioned as Moab's ancestral land in Deuteronomy.
